content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy to build muscle. 💪 Research shows that loads from roughly 30% to 85% of your 1RM can all build similar muscle, as long as your sets are taken close to failure (within about 0–3 reps) and you do enough weekly volume.

Since your goal is a 100 kg bench in three months, you do need heavy work for that. Strength is specific, so heavy sets of 1–6 reps will help your bench. Use lighter sets of 8–15 reps as extra volume for size. Ain't nothin' but a peanut! 🔥
